'''
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_text(poc)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"data/size","code":"ASS_Track *track = ass_read_memory(ass_library, (char *)data, size, nullptr);","note":"The fuzz input is parsed as an ASS subtitle document."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1342,"var":"newbuf","code":"memcpy(newbuf, buf, bufsize); newbuf[bufsize] = '\\0';","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated buffer."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1346,"var":"track","code":"track = parse_memory(library, buf);","note":"The subtitle parser produces track and event structures from the input."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_tags","line":524,"var":"render_priv->state.family.len","code":"render_priv->state.family.len = args->end - start;","note":"The \\fn override stores an empty font family string view with zero length when the tag has no explicit name."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_tags","line":527,"var":"render_priv->state.family.str","code":"update_font(render_priv);","note":"The zero-length family string is left active because the parser does not reject it before updating the font."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"update_font","line":1002,"var":"desc.family","code":"desc.family = render_priv->state.family;","note":"The font descriptor copies the attacker-controlled string view into the font cache key."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_cache_template.h","function":"<global>","line":41,"var":"p->member.str / p->member.len","code":"hval = fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval);","note":"The cache hash helper forwards len=0 to the FNV routine."},
{"step":8,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_utils.h","function":"<global>","line":186,"var":"len == 0","code":"static inline uint32_t fnv_32a_buf(const void *buf, size_t len, uint32_t hval)","note":"The helper does not special-case empty input, so the loop dereferences buf even for an empty string and crashes."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(dumps(trace))

python3 - <<'PY'
print(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read())
